name: Quantum Engraving #004 — Marangoni Vortex
description:
The hydrodynamics of liquid silicon governed by thermocapillary forces. As surface tension drops drastically under scorching focal irradiation (dγ/dT = -1.6 x 10^-4 N/m·K), molten fluids are pulled radially towards colder peripheries, weaving closed hydrodynamic vortex cells in glowing teal, cyan, and liquid amber that shape the cavity sidewalls.

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork visualizes the Navier-Stokes hydrodynamic equations coupled with tangential Marangoni shear stress.

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
